title: 2027 MINI Countryman Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: The 2027 MINI Countryman gains a new adventure-oriented Untamed Edition trim, along with some minor spec upgrades.
body_markdown:
This not-so-mini MINI is currently in its third generation and was all-new in 2025. The Countryman sits in the compact luxury crossover class, with primary competitors including the BMW X1, the Audi Q3, the Mercedes-Benz GLA, and the Volvo XC40. The 2027 MINI Countryman has nine trims: S Oxford Edition, S Signature Plus, S Iconic, S Untamed Edition, SE Electric Signature Plus, SE Electric Iconic, SE Untamed Edition, JCW Signature Plus, and JCW Iconic.

## What’s New for the 2027 MINI Countryman


The new generation of MINI Countryman was introduced for 2025, so there aren’t any significant design changes for the 2027 model year. There are some equipment changes, though, as well as a new adventure-oriented Untamed Edition trim. It includes 19-inch wheels, all-terrain tires, a revised suspension, dark exterior accents, and all-weather floor and cargo mats. It’s available with both S and SE variants. Other changes for 2027 include a trailer hitch as part of the Favoured Style package and a universal garage door opener that becomes a standalone option for some trims.


## Design


The MINI Countryman is a puffed-up SUV version of the petite Cooper hatchback. Similar to the Cooper, the Countryman offers vibrant color options as well as a few mirror-cap, wheel-cover, and roof-color options. Additionally, the Countryman offers style packages for the Signature Plus and Iconic trims that change some of the exterior accents. The Favoured Style offers silver or black trim accents, and the JCW Style Package has sport brakes, piano black exterior accents, exclusive black wheels, and an aero body kit. Standard wheels are 17 inches, but 18-inch, 19-inch, and 20-inch wheels are available depending on the trim level.


## Powertrain


The 2027 Countryman comes standard with all-wheel drive and offers three powertrain options: a 241-horsepower 2.0-liter four-cylinder, a 312-hp 2.0-liter turbo four-cylinder, or a 308-hp dual electric motor setup. For the gas models, the EPA estimates between 23 mpg and 24 mpg in the city and between 29 mpg and 32 mpg on the highway, depending on trim. The EV has up to 216 miles of electric range with 18-inch wheels. When properly equipped, the maximum towing capacity is 3,500 pounds for the gas model and 2,645 pounds for the EV. While the Untamed Edition isn’t positioned as a serious off-roader, it does get 8.8 inches of ground clearance, all-terrain tires, and hill-descent control.


## Interior


The interior is modern yet classic, with a large, round screen on the center stack that harks back to the original Mini. Standard seating surfaces are a cloth/leatherette combo, but full leatherette is available. The seats, dashboard, and door panels have interesting color accents paired with buyers' seating color of choice that ranges from gray to black to brown to blue. The Countryman seats five, with 37 inches of rear legroom that’s generous for the sector. Cargo space is middle of the pack, with 25 cubic feet behind the second row and 56.2 cubic feet with rear seats folded flat. A panoramic moonroof is standard for Signature Plus trims and above.


## Technology


The 2027 Countryman has a unique 9.4-inch circular OLED screen that features a cloud-based navigation system as well as wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration. Other standard tech features include a head-up display, wireless phone charging, MINI Experience Modes, connected services (subscription required), voice-activated temperature and audio controls, and a multi-speaker stereo system. Available tech features include a premium 12-speaker Harman Kardon sound system, a digital key, remote start, navigation with augmented reality, an interior camera, and a surround-view camera.

## Safety


The 2027 Countryman has a lot of standard and available safety tech. All trims come with blind-spot monitors, lane-departure warning, automatic emergency braking, rear cross-traffic alert, high-beam assist, and a drive recorder that stores information and footage after an accident. Available features include a low-speed hands-free driving function, adaptive cruise control, lane-change assist, automated parking assistance, a surround-view camera, and a backup assistance feature that can retrace the vehicle's path when reversing. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration hadn’t crash-tested the current Countryman at the time of writing. The Insurance Institute for Highway Safety had partially tested the 2027 model and gave it Good crashworthiness scores in the small front overlap test and updated side test, plus mostly Good ratings in the crash avoidance and mitigation tests.


## Pricing and Release Date


The 2027 MINI Countryman went on sale in mid-2026, and the entry-level Oxford Edition started at $36,250 at the time of writing. Buyers looking for it on the “build” page of the miniusa.com website won’t find it there, because it’s treated as a special-edition model and has its own landing page. The Countryman S models—Signature Plus, Iconic, and Untamed—start at $40,250, $43,650, and $45,250, respectively. The electric SE models, the Signature Plus and Iconic, start at $46,550 and $49,950. Pricing for the SE Untamed Edition hadn’t been announced at the time of writing. Rounding out the sporty lineup, the JCW Signature Plus and Iconic start at $48,250 and $50,750. Looking at the style packages, the Favoured Style with piano black exterior trim adds $350, and the JCW Style adds $1,400 ($750 on the SE). Chili Red II paint is free with the Signature Plus trim only, while the metallic paints add $650. The Comfort Package Plus and Comfort Package Max, which add advanced driver-assistance features, are only available for the top-tier Iconic trim and cost $900 and $1,100 respectively.
